en_title: In GTA 6, Doomscrolling Is a Necessity If You Want to See Everything
cn_title: 在《GTA6》中，想要看遍所有内容就必须刷负面信息
opus_summary: 《GTA6》评测者Luke Reilly称，他通过游戏内社交媒体Snapmatic上的帖子解锁了一条新任务线。Simon Cardy也通过社交媒体发现了新机会，相关地点会自动标记在地图上；游戏内广播和公告栏也能提供任务线索。

paragraphs.en: Ever since that first trailer , we knew social media would play an important part in GTA 6. A good chunk of those first 90 seconds was faux TikTok footage, after all. And now that reviews are out , and the game is live in New Zealand, Australia, and many other places on that side of the planet, we have a better idea of how GTA 6’s in-universe social media operates. One thing’s for certain: you’ll need to be scrolling if you want to see everything the world has to offer.
paragraphs.cn: 自从首支预告片发布以来，我们就知道社交媒体将在《GTA6》中扮演重要角色。毕竟，那最初的90秒里有相当大一部分都是仿制的TikTok视频。如今评测已经出炉，游戏也已在新西兰、澳大利亚以及地球另一端的许多其他地方上线，我们对《GTA6》世界中的社交媒体如何运作有了更清楚的了解。有一件事是肯定的：如果你想看遍这个世界提供的所有内容，就得不断刷社交媒体。

paragraphs.en: As part of IGN’s Ask Me Anything livestream earlier today, reviewer Luke Reilly explained how he unlocked a new mission chain based on a post he saw on Snapmatic, the GTA universe’s parody of Instagram.
paragraphs.cn: 在今天早些时候IGN的「有问必答」直播中，评测者Luke Reilly讲述了自己如何根据在Snapmatic上看到的一则帖子解锁了一条新的任务线。Snapmatic是《GTA》世界中对Instagram的戏仿。

paragraphs.en: “I was scrolling through the game’s social media, and I saw a post from this guy on a farm looking for a pilot, and it pings it on the map for you,” he said. “It’ll ping in an undiscovered part of the map that there’s something there because you’ve spotted it on social media.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我当时正在刷游戏里的社交媒体，看到一个农场里的人发帖寻找飞行员，游戏就会替你在地图上标出来。因为你在社交媒体上看到了这条信息，它会在地图上尚未探索的区域标示出那里有东西。」

paragraphs.en: IGN’s Simon Cardy, who has also played over 100 hours of the game and is currently answering your questions over on our launch live blog , confirms that he also used social media to discover new opportunities, which are then automatically pinned to the game’s map.
paragraphs.cn: IGN的Simon Cardy也已经游玩了这款游戏超过100小时，目前正在我们的发售实时博客中回答大家的问题。他证实，自己也通过社交媒体发现了新的机会，这些机会随后会自动标记在游戏地图上。

paragraphs.en: Simon also notes that you’ll hear about opportunities on the in-game radio, although those are hints you’ll need to follow up on yourself – only certain mediums will pin a mission to your map. Aside from social media posts, pamphlets on local bulletin boards will also drop mission markers on your map, something Luke described in today’s AMA: “One of the cool things is that you see signs around [advertising] for a pilot. It’s visual storytelling; you can [follow the instructions] and go there and do jobs for this character that you meet.”
paragraphs.cn: Simon还指出，你会在游戏内的广播中听到一些机会，但这些线索需要你自己进一步跟进——只有某些媒介会将任务标记在地图上。除了社交媒体帖子，当地公告板上的传单也会在地图上添加任务标记，Luke在今天的「有问必答」中谈到了这一点：「有意思的一点是，你会在周围看到寻找飞行员的［广告］。这是一种视觉叙事；你可以［按照指示］前往那里，为遇到的这个角色干活。」

paragraphs.en: Bulletin boards are, of course, nothing new for video games – you’ll no doubt have picked up hundreds of bounties and side quests from boards in dozens of RPGs across the years. But GTA 6’s use of the internet and social media is more novel. Simon also notes that there are connections to be found across the in-game web, too – a story on the news app may lead you to investigate a topic on Snapmatic, which in turn will pin a new mission to the map.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，公告板在电子游戏中并不是什么新鲜事物——多年来，你无疑已经在几十款RPG中从公告板上接下过数百个悬赏和支线任务。但《GTA6》对互联网和社交媒体的运用则更新颖。Simon还指出，游戏内的网络上也能找到彼此关联的内容——新闻应用上的一篇报道可能会引导你在Snapmatic上调查某个话题，进而在地图上标记出一个新任务。

paragraphs.en: In short: we may call it doomscrolling in real life, but it’s a pretty handy activity to do in GTA 6. While I expect there will be multiple ways to stumble across the game’s many, many missions, it seems a fun and authentic method to discover things on social media.
paragraphs.cn: 简而言之：我们在现实生活中或许会把这种行为称为不停刷负面信息，但在《GTA6》中，这么做相当有用。虽然我预计玩家会有多种方式偶然发现游戏中数量众多的任务，但通过社交媒体发现内容似乎是一种有趣而真实的方式。

paragraphs.en: For more GTA 6, be sure to check out our breakdown of how long it takes to complete its campaign , as well as our brand new interview with Rockstar’s Rob Nelson . And if you want to see the game in action, you can watch 15 minutes of the game’s first mission .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《GTA6》内容，请务必查看我们对完成游戏剧情所需时间的详细说明，以及我们对Rockstar的Rob Nelson的最新采访。如果你想看看游戏的实际游玩画面，还可以观看游戏第一个任务的15分钟视频。

paragraphs.en: Matt Purslow is IGN's Executive Editor of Features.
paragraphs.cn: Matt Purslow是IGN的特稿执行编辑。
